title: Derive PSK federation keys from the complete configured PSK
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs accepts PSKs longer than 16 bytes and federation_identifier hashes the complete PSK, but derive_context passes only self.psk[..16] to OSCORE. Two configurations with identical first 16 bytes and different suffixes therefore produce identical traffic keys while is_isolated_from reports them isolated. Either enforce an exact 16-byte PSK or KDF the complete PSK into the 16-byte OSCORE master secret, and add a suffix-difference key/isolation test.
